newsitem.title: USA: Eli Lilly, Emisphere in pact.
newsitem.headline: Eli Lilly, Emisphere in pact.

text.p: Emisphere Technologies Inc and Eli Lilly and Co said Thursday they had entered into a strategic alliance to utilize Emisphere's technology for the improved delivery of therapeutic proteins, with a focus on oral delivery.

Under the agreement, Emisphere could receive $60 million, consisting of initial fees, funding for research, milestone payments for oral formulations of two proteins, and payments for limited rights to a selected number of additional Lilly proteins, the companies said.
Emisphere could receive further payments for other delivery applications or if the additional proteins are licensed.
Emisphere will also receive royalties on sales of any products utilizing its technology.
A significant portion of the post-Phase III milestones will be creditable against future royalties.
The major therapeutic focus of the collaboration is in the area of endocrinology, including growth disorders.
Lilly will receive exclusive worldwide commercialization rights to products that result from the collaboration.
